source_revision: Research source snapshot identified by the file hashes below.

m10.implementation: ConditionedFactorizedDecoder: fitted Ridge anchor plus cross-attention residual with a conditional Gaussian output
m10.inference_inputs: EEG only; target data and within-paradigm class labels are not inputs
m10.output_coordinates: 64 fitting-fold standardized target PCA coordinates; inverse projection restores run-centred prepared surface coordinates
m10.checkpoint_covariance: The included checkpoint has zero covariance factors and therefore a diagonal conditional covariance.

hb.implementation: One pooled EEG StandardScaler/PCA/PLS encoder with separate MI and MA Ridge response heads
hb.source_fit_core: practice_shared_hb_functional_20261001.py:99-140, fixed selected paired configuration; downstream selection omitted
hb.inference_inputs: EEG features plus acquisition protocol MI or MA; no within-protocol class labels
hb.output_coordinates: 144 baseline-corrected Hb response means/slopes, not full temporal waveforms
inference_behavior: Single-protocol inference skips the absent protocol head. Unknown protocol values raise ValueError.

coverage: single-protocol Hb inference and rejection of unknown protocols

scope: M10 checkpoint inference, loss gradients and fixed-configuration Hb fitting were compared with their research sources. Model-to-result correspondence is documented in methods.md.
